fragen.frage: A classmate speaks English with a strong accent. What is the most respectful reaction?
optionen: Listen carefully and respond respectfully.
Laugh because it sounds different.
Say their English is wrong without listening.
Ignore the person completely.
fragen.erklaerung: Unterschiedliche Akzente gehören zur sprachlichen Vielfalt und verdienen Respekt.

fragen.frage: Someone shares a tradition from their family. What is a good response?
optionen: Ask interested questions without judging.
Say your own tradition is better.
Change the topic immediately.
Call it strange before understanding it.
fragen.erklaerung: Neugier und Respekt fördern interkulturelles Lernen.

fragen.frage: You see an unfamiliar festival in a video. What is the best first step?
optionen: Learn about the context before judging it.
Decide immediately that it makes no sense.
Assume everyone in that country celebrates it in the same way.
Ignore all cultural information.
fragen.erklaerung: Kulturelle Praktiken versteht man besser, wenn man ihren Hintergrund kennt.

fragen.frage: Why should we avoid saying that all English-speaking people are the same?
optionen: Because English is spoken in many countries and communities.
Because only one English-speaking country exists.
Because culture never changes.
Because languages have no connection to people.
fragen.erklaerung: Der englischsprachige Raum ist vielfältig und nicht einheitlich.

fragen.frage: If you do not understand a cultural reference in a text, what is sensible?
optionen: Ask politely or look it up in a reliable source.
Pretend it must be stupid.
Skip the whole text forever.
Assume your first guess is always correct.
fragen.erklaerung: Nachfragen oder Recherchieren hilft, Missverständnisse zu vermeiden.

fragen.frage: When comparing two festivals, what is a respectful approach?
optionen: Notice similarities and differences without ranking them.
Decide that only your own festival matters.
Make jokes about unfamiliar customs.
Refuse to compare anything.

fragen.frage: Why can two people from the same country still have different opinions and habits?
optionen: Because people have individual experiences and identities.
Because culture controls everyone in exactly the same way.
Because only tourists have different views.
Because language decides every opinion.
fragen.erklaerung: Kultur beeinflusst Menschen, bestimmt sie aber nicht vollständig.

fragen.frage: For a project about English-speaking cultures, which source choice is strongest?
optionen: Reliable sources and authentic voices from different contexts
Only one random social media comment
A meme without context
Your first stereotype
fragen.erklaerung: Gute Quellen helfen, differenziert und fair über Kulturen zu sprechen.
